title: One outage, millions affected. What went wrong at Microsoft?
summary: Problems with Exchange Online spread across Microsoft 365 and external businesses, highlighting how dependent workplaces have become on shared cloud infrastructure.
llm_summary: A recent outage in Microsoft’s Exchange Online rippled through the broader Microsoft 365 suite and even impacted external businesses, exposing how many workplaces now rely on a single cloud platform for core communications. The incident highlighted the risks of that dependency—when a centralized service falters, a cascade of disruptions can affect millions of users and critical business operations worldwide.
